statement: For the frozen d=4 hypercube polynomial H_4(x)=B(x)-A(x)(sum_v x_v)^3 defined in source.md and problem.md, H_4(x) is nonnegative for every x in the nonnegative orthant whose sixteen coordinates take at most two distinct values.
contribution: An exact coefficientwise proof of a broad subsidiary case of the unresolved sixteen-variable inequality: a complete enumeration of all 32767 unordered nontrivial vertex bipartitions shows that every coefficient of the resulting homogeneous bivariate polynomial is nonnegative. The result narrows any possible counterexample to vectors with at least three distinct coordinate values; limited current primary-source screening found no equivalent statement, but no exhaustive priority claim is made.
